regression.bugClass: A generated furniture cluster can bring its own floor material into a room whose canonical floor is different, and the evidence is reviewed with an actor standing in front of it.
regression.lesson: When integrating a generated interaction cluster, inspect the ENTIRE cluster footprint for imported environmental material, especially floor, walls and furniture seams that were hidden by actors during review.
regression.asserts: Every floor pixel of every cluster footprint is inside a repair rect or inside a rect explicitly written off with a reason; the floor band comes from the ROOM's own mask, never from the repair, because a repair that declares its own band covers it by construction; and every clearance is pinned to the plate's sha256, so a new plate makes them all stale. recomposition2026_09_12.ruling: Recompose in the correct order: restore a clean background first, then place the people. Zero pixels of a person's previous environment may travel with the person. Do not optimise for zero image operations or a low changed-pixel count.
recomposition2026_09_12.stepA: tools/retrofit/nugget-bar-reconstruct.py -- the empty room. Starts from rebuild-01, erases the patron entirely, and rebuilds the bar and the floor behind him. THE BAR IS A STRAIGHT RUN IN PERSPECTIVE and its horizontal lines converge on the room's own horizon y 239, so with the counter's lit front edge measured (y = 383 + 0.2135(x-1185), rms 2 px over 720 px) the run rectifies to an undistorted elevation in (w, v) = (ln(TOP-239), (y-239)/(TOP-239)). Wall and back bar in register from the plate this bar was composed into; the bar front from the people-free accepted bar mapped into that elevation and rescaled from its 0.117 bay pitch to this bar's 0.083; the floor in register from the accepted cold-dirt plate. The card cluster's plank floor is repaired here too, in the same step, because it is background.
